  "analysis": "The projectile collision loop checks m.hit.Contains(u), but clears the set at each accepted collision without recording the target. The return transition also clears the set, which would support separate outward and return hit accounting if targets were recorded. This is a suspected cause pending execution. The scenario checks a stationary target at two simulation step sizes, separates outward and return damage, and includes an off-path control.
